# Forge-based PR association

PRs are associated based on the forge API results (the gateway's list_merged_prs) rather than commit parentage; the system treats merged PRs reported by the forge as the source of truth (suitable for squash/rebase workflows).

Ensure PR identity and association are derived from the forge itself so the reconciliation is robust to squash/rebase and not dependent on commit ancestry.
